newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast products flat ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast products flat ahead of holiday.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot product prices were unchanged Tuesday as an absence of players before Wednesday's Christmas holiday quashed sales.
Meanwhile, NYMEX January gasoline rose 0.66 cents to 68.90 cents a gallon in abbreviated NYMEX trade.
Front-month heating oil climbed 0.32 cents a gallon to 71.08 cents.
Bids for Los Angeles unleaded CARB gasoline remained 74 cents a gallon, while offers stayed 75 cents.
CARB diesel held at notional levels of 73/74 cents a gallon, and "EPA" quality diesel was unchanged at 71/72 cents.
